parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: The rotation lid is the top cover of the toolbox, made of steel, providing protection and closure for the internal compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a hinged cover that can be opened or closed to access or secure the contents of the toolbox.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge axis located at the back of the box, allowing upward and downward movement.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of steel, designed to hold tools or small items within the toolbox.
parts.Functional_description: It provides organized storage and can be pulled out to access tools or pushed in to store them securely.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails or guides, allowing smooth in-and-out sliding motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural component of the toolbox, made of steel, providing support and housing for drawers and the lid.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the frame that holds all other parts together and provides stability and durability to the entire structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
